overview: Brunei is a small country on the north coast of the island of Borneo, split into two parts by Malaysia. Its capital is Bandar Seri Begawan. Brunei is ruled by a sultan and became independent from the United Kingdom in 1984. Oil and gas have made it one of the wealthiest countries in Asia.

geography.text: Brunei faces the South China Sea, and most of the country is covered by tropical rainforest, much of it protected. The capital is famous for Kampong Ayer, a 'water village' of houses built on stilts over the Brunei River.
